data.body:
1879 PS1 CI RCA (rebar-debug Phase 1).

Confirmed root cause: the os.walk repair introduced two ambient `Path(dirpath)` factory calls in tests/conftest.py:353,358. The three Windows-simulation tests at tests/unit/test_enrich_drain.py:163,206,322 monkeypatch `D.os.name="nt"`; src/rebar/llm/enrich_drain.py:20 and tests/conftest.py:22 share the same stdlib os module, and the cleanup fixture tears down before monkeypatch restoration. On supported Python 3.11, pathlib.Path.__new__ consults the live os.name, selects WindowsPath, and rejects it on POSIX. The os.walk dirpath itself is an ordinary absolute POSIX string; the failure is ambient concrete-path selection during teardown, not malformed path data or vanished-lock handling.

CI evidence: run 32198213506 job 95906676612 produced exactly three teardown errors after all three bodies passed; 13,897 other tests passed. Ubuntu/Python 3.12 passed. Local Python 3.11 exact-node reproduction was deterministic: 3 passed + the same 3 teardown errors.

Discriminating proof: immediately before conversion under Python 3.11, os.name=`nt`, `D.os is os` was true, dirpath was a normal `str`, and tmp_path was PosixPath. `Path(dirpath)` raised `NotImplementedError: cannot instantiate WindowsPath`; `type(tmp_path)(dirpath)` succeeded as PosixPath. Driving the cleanup generator with the monkeypatch active reproduced the error; restoring os.name before cleanup completed normally. The minimal version probe reproduced 3.11 error versus 3.12 construction. These outcomes confirm the shared-monkeypatch/factory hypothesis and reject generic os.walk/path corruption, lock-churn/onerror behavior, and permanent traversal corruption.

Defect legitimacy: defect. Python 3.11 is supported by pyproject.toml:16 and the CI matrix; the cleanup contract in tests/unit/test_ci_snapshot_fixture_cleanup.py requires removable snapshot trees, adjacent-data preservation, and propagation of non-FileNotFoundError scan failures.

Caller-dependency gate: expected post-fix behavior is identical recursive exact `.rebar/run_snapshots` discovery with FNF-only walk tolerance, independent of a test-scoped os.name monkeypatch. The fixture is autouse; its only direct test hook is tests/unit/test_ci_snapshot_fixture_cleanup.py:27. No caller behaviorally depends on ambient Path flavor selection. Phase 2 is unlocked; the repair must preserve os.walk and must not broaden exception masking.
